title: feat(studio): external-object fields show their datasource and write state; no DDL controls on an external object
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiVy7F2atKWpo5rp3YPrqddh)_
Fixes #27279

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** Studio 对象设计器（字段画布与字段检查器）里，带 `external` 绑定的外部对象：每个字段标「来自 数据源名 · 只读或可写」，画布顶部一条说明；不再出现「添加字段」、批量删除，字段检查器里 API 名与类型置灰、无复制与删除。
- **为什么改：** 外部对象的表属于远端数据库，平台从不对它做 DDL；以前设计器照常提供加列、改类型、删字段，而平台不会对远端表执行这些改动（ADR-0015 欠的 Studio 半边，裁决 D6 的 P1 部分）。
- **风险与回滚：** 只影响带 `external` 的对象的设计器界面，平台自有对象不变；不改元数据协议、不改服务端。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看：** `previews/external-object.tsx`（判定与写入状态，含数据源读取）→ `previews/ObjectFormCanvas.tsx`（隐藏加字段与批量删除）→ `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`（`ddlLocked` 一行决定四个控件）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/external-object.test.tsx`，预期 11 passed；其中一条断言中文标记为「来自 plan_gantt · 只读」且无「添加字段」按钮。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

An object that carries an ADR-0015 `external` binding is never a DDL target (the runtime's own test is the same presence check, `isFederatedObject` in `@objectstack/objectql`). The object designer under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin` now reads `object.external` / `object.datasource` and:

- **Marks every field.** Each field row on the canvas and the field inspector carry a badge "From DATASOURCE · STATE" (zh: 「来自 DATASOURCE · 只读」), and a note above the canvas names the datasource and says why fields cannot be reshaped there.
- **Write state, never guessed.** ADR-0015 writes need both `datasource.external.allowWrites` and `object.external.writable` (the engine's write gate, `assertWriteAllowed`). Without `writable: true` on the object the state is settled from the object alone: Read-only, and no request is made. With it, the datasource is read through the metadata door (`GET /meta/datasource/NAME`, the same item `DatasourcePreview` reads `external.allowWrites` from): both set ⇒ Writable, otherwise Read-only, and a datasource that cannot be read ⇒ "Writes unconfirmed" with a tooltip naming the missing half. The read is keyed on the datasource name, not on the client's identity (`ui/AGENTS.md` #10).
- **Hides the DDL affordances**, each read from the code:
  | Control | Where | Why it is DDL |
  |:---|:---|:---|
  | Add field (bottom bar, empty state, section header "+") | `ObjectFormCanvas` `addField` | appends a field = a new remote column |
  | Bulk Delete | `ObjectFormCanvas` `bulkDelete` | removes fields = drops remote columns |
  | API name input | `ObjectFieldInspector` `setKey` | renames the field key = renames the column |
  | Type picker | `ObjectFieldInspector` `changeType` | retypes the column |
  | Duplicate | `ObjectFieldInspector` `duplicateField` | adds a field |
  | Remove | `ObjectFieldInspector` `removeField` | drops the column |

  The label-to-API-name derivation (`deriveNameFor`) is also off on an external object, since it renames the key. Kept: label, inline label rename, sections, ordering, bulk move-to-section, and the other display/validation settings, which change only platform metadata.
- **Strings:** six `designer.external.*` rows in the `studio` namespace of `@object-ui/i18n` (`en` + `zh`), the folder's existing i18n mechanism.

## Tests

`previews/external-object.test.tsx` (new, 11 cases): the binding reader; on the canvas, per-field and header badges "From plan_gantt · Read-only" with no datasource read, the zh mark 「来自 plan_gantt · 只读」 with no 「添加字段」, no Add field on an empty external object nor on a section header, bulk move kept and bulk delete dropped, the three `writable: true` outcomes (allowWrites ⇒ Writable, no allowWrites ⇒ Read-only, read failure ⇒ unconfirmed); in the field inspector, API name and Type disabled, Duplicate and Remove absent, Label still editable. Each group has a platform-owned-object control case that keeps every control.

## Acceptance notes

- **Studio Data pillar is not covered by this PR.** `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (outside this card's file surface, `views/metadata-admin/**`) has its own add-field doors: the records grid's "+" column (`onAddColumn` → `AddFieldPopover`) and the Form layout designer's `onAddField`. Its right rail reuses `ObjectFieldInspector`, so there the badge shows and rename / retype / duplicate / remove are already gone, but the grid and form-designer "Add field" still show for an external object. Named in the dev report for a follow-up.
- The Ask AI button on the canvas's bottom bar stays; it opens the assistant and adds nothing by itself.
- The datasource read happens only for `writable: true` objects; the canvas and the field inspector each read it once per datasource name.
